VOICE_START=%s
VOICE_ARGS=%s
CLIENT_PID=%s
CLIENT_START=%s
CLIENT_ARGS=%s
' "$VPID" "$VSTART" "$VARGS" "$CPID" "$CSTART" "$CARGS"; test "$VPID" = 2720334; test "$CPID" = 2719881; printf '%s' "$VARGS" | grep -Fq '/home/ai-core-node/.local/lib/frankenstein-voice-final/scripts/voice_final_runtime.py'; printf '%s' "$CARGS" | grep -Fq '/home/ai-core-node/.local/lib/frankenstein-voice-final/scripts/voice_host_777_live_client.py'; echo OMEGA_RUNTIME_STABLE_PASS
